hypothesis: V17 terminalization can close the measured gap by consuming the existing immutable effect execution-generation fence plus durable V16 ingress ancestry and one coherent canonical GWT/use/prediction/causal/delta support chain, rather than creating a second execution authority.
strongest_counterhypotheses: Requiring the original execution to remain currently BUSY would be stronger but could incorrectly reject legitimate read-only reconciliation after crash/generation turnover; durable original-generation ancestry should be sufficient for provenance while current-writer/recovery authority remains a separate gate.
Referentially real support rows may still be causally invalid if receiver closure is incomplete, the prediction belongs to another subject/cycle, or causal credit is merely CORRELATED_ONLY.
A no-learning path that erases GWT/use/causal provenance may be simpler but would convert absence of semantic-delta learning into absence of causal terminalization evidence.
